title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Is Officially Getting a New U.S Release After Finale
content:
While the Solo Leveling: Ragnarok webtoon continues its indefinite hiatus, the novel has already bid farewell to fans. Written by Daul, the series serves as the official spin-off of the original Solo Leveling franchise. It follows Jinwoo’s son, Sung Juho, in an alternate universe where he awakens his powers and fights against cosmic beings. Thanks to the popularity of the original series, Ragnarok became a massive hit after its release and continues to grow in popularity. While the Korean version of the novel ended last year, the English translation of the novel returned to Tapas earlier this month with final chapters after it went on hiatus in September last year.

However, even though the novel has also been concluded on Tapas, that’s far from the end of the series. Following Anime NYC this month, the official X handle of Ize Press confirmed that the Solo Leveling: Ragnarok novel is getting its first-ever English print in the U.S. While the release date hasn’t been confirmed in the post, we can expect an announcement by the end of the year or in the first half of 2027. In July this year, Ize Press also released the webtoon’s first volume in print, and it has already confirmed the release dates of the second and third volumes .

When Will Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Webtoon Return?

The webtoon went on an indefinite hiatus earlier this year after the second season finale. Webtoon artists often take months of breaks between seasons to prepare for the weekly serialization. However, while the hiatus between the first and second seasons wasn’t nearly long enough, Season 3 will have a major change. The reason Season 3 is taking so much longer is that the lead artist, Jin, will be replaced following his enlistment in the mandatory military service.

Since it typically lasts for 18-21 months, the publishers can’t wait that long for Jin to return. Since there haven’t been any official updates on the new artist and the webtoon’s return, it’s impossible to determine when it will return. The first two seasons are currently available on Tapas, where we can expect the upcoming season to drop after the webtoon is released in South Korea.

Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Deserves Its Own Anime

While the webtoon is still ongoing, the novel has reached its conclusion, so it’s about time it also gets an anime adaptation. Solo Leveling: Ragnarok not only introduces new characters but also brings back some of the most beloved characters from the original story to keep fans hyped.

Additionally, the series is more than popular enough, with a huge fanbase who will be thrilled to follow the journey of Jinwoo’s son. However, since the original anime hasn’t wrapped up the story yet, it’s uncertain if Ragnarok will get an anime adaptation before that. In the meantime, you can catch up with both the webtoon and novel on Tapas.

title: All 4 Persona 3 Anime Films Stream on Aniplex USA YouTube Channel for Limited Time
content:
The four films are available in Japanese with English subtitles. Atlus West stated the films are available for a limited time, but did not state when the videos would be removed. The videos are available in North America, Central America, South America, the U.K., Ireland, South Africa, Australia, and New Zealand.

Aniplex of America is streaming the films for free in celebration of the 30th anniversary of the Persona series.

The first film premiered in Japan in November 2013. The second film opened in June 2014, the third film opened in April 2015, and the fourth film opened in January 2016.

Tomohisa Taguchi ( Persona 3 the Movie #2 Midsummer Knight's Dream , Persona 4 the Golden Animation ) took over as director for the fourth film at A-1 Pictures from a screenplay by Jun Kumagai with supervision by Seiji Kishi . Zenou Tanioka of Bihou, Inc. returned as art director from the second film, after Toshihiro Kohama served in that role for the third film. Junpei Takatsu was the composite and visual director. Keisuke Watabe designed the characters for the film, and Shoji Meguro and Tetsuya Kobayashi scored the soundtrack.

Aniplex of America released the first film in May 2014, followed by the second film in March 2015, the third film in January 2016, and the fourth film in August 2016.

title: Demon Slayer Drops New Look At The Strongest Hashira Ahead of His Biggest Fight
content:
Demon Slayer still has a long way to go before the finale, even after the anime has commenced the Infinity Castle Arc. The first installment of the trilogy premiered in July 2025 in Japan before hitting the international theatres in September of the same year. Even more than a year after the first film was released, the animation studio has stayed silent on the upcoming film. The first part was only the beginning, and there is a lot of intense action that fans have yet to see. Since the Infinity Castle Arc features the final battle against the Upper Moons, all the Corps Members fought inside the endless labyrinth. Most of the main cast also got their spotlight, especially the Hashira who clashed with the powerful demons.

This also includes Gyomei Himejima, the strongest Hashira in the Corps. Although as the Stone Hashira, his powers are undeniable, he has yet to fight any battle in the anime. However, before fans get to see him in action, the official website of Demon Slayer drops a new birthday visual for him. August 23rd is his birthday, and just like each year, he got an adorable chibi-style visual based on this year’s theme. The background and his outfit follow a similar color palette to his color design in the series, with the exception of a small crown placed on his head.

Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Will Feature The Biggest Battle Gyomei Ever Fought

While the anime has already confirmed that Gyomei is the strongest Hashira, fans have yet to see him in action. However, thanks to the Hashira Training Arc and his brief appearance in the first Infinity Castle film, it’s evident that his strength is on another level compared to any other member in the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei will have his first fight in the upcoming film of the Infinity Castle .

Not to mention that the Upper Moon is the most powerful enemy he will ever face. Even with all his strength, he couldn’t fight the demon one-on-one and had to rely on his comrades for aid. Without spoiling much for anime-only fans, at the very least we can confirm that his fight in the Infinity Castle is one of the most intense and thrilling in the entire story. Gyomei has a huge role to play in the final stretch of the story as well, and he’s only going to get more popular among fans after the anime wraps up the main story.

Does Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2 Have a Release Date?

So far, Ufotable hasn’t shared any updates regarding the upcoming film, including a first look or even a release window. Since the anime’s debut in 2019, Demon Slayer has returned with either a new season or a film every year, but 2026 is the first time the series didn’t release anything new.

This is probably because the studio requires more time, as the production quality of the Infinity Castle films is unlike anything they have ever done. On the bright side, the first part of the trilogy began streaming on Crunchyroll in July this year. The studio isn’t going to make fans wait too long, so we can also expect more updates by the end of the year or in the first half of 2027.

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Inside Men Prequel Film Confirms Main Cast
content:
Jung-woo Ha , Bo-hyun Ahn, Hae-joon Park, and Sung-il Jung have been cast in Inside Men: The Birth of Villains (working title), a prequel to the 2015 South Korean film Inside Men , production company Hive Media Corp announced on August 20.

Set in the late 1980s, the film will explore the origins of the power cartel portrayed in the original movie, tracing how the worlds of media, capital, and politics became intertwined.

Ha will play Kang-hee Lee, a newspaper reporter who is pushed into a less prominent position after pursuing a major corporate corruption story. The character was played by Yoon-sik Baek in Inside Men .

Ahn will play Sang-goo Ahn, an entertainment agency executive who rises from the bottom while pursuing success and revenge. Byung-hun Lee played the character in the original film.

Park will portray Pil-woo Jang, a first-term lawmaker and ambitious politician seeking to rise to the center of power, while Jung will play Hyun-soo Oh, the chairman of Mirae Group who seeks to establish himself at the top of the emerging cartel.

While previously the staff had stated the work would be a film trilogy, this latest announcement of the cast did not include mention of a trilogy, so it is currently unclear how many films will be in the project.

Based on the unfinished webtoon created by Tae-ho Yoon, who is known for webtoons like Yahoo and Misaeng: Incomplete Life , Inside Men was previously adapted into the 2015 hit film of the same name.

The story follows a network of powerful figures — a presidential candidate, a corporate tycoon, and a media strategist — entangled in deep political corruption and backdoor dealings. A small-time enforcer who once served them becomes a scapegoat after a secret slush fund scheme is exposed, leaving him broken and seeking revenge.

Meanwhile, an ambitious prosecutor with no influential background gets a rare chance to take down the country's biggest corruption ring, only to have his investigation derailed. As the two men's paths collide, each driven by his own sense of justice and ambition, a dangerous power struggle unfolds beneath the surface of politics, money, and the media.

The Inside Men webtoon does not currently have an official English release, but other series by Yoon such as The Hooligans , Eorin , Moss , Operation Chromite , and Misaeng: Incomplete Life have English releases.

title: Scandal Rock Band to End Activities in August 2027
content:
Japanese rock band Scandal announced on Monday that the band will end activities on August 21, 2027. The band, making the announcement after their recently-concluded 20th anniversary concert on Friday, stated that all four members feel that they have done all that they could together, being able to travel throughout Japan and around the world as Scandal. As part of their final journey, the band will tour all 47 prefectures of Japan starting in October, and will hold a solo concert at Yokohama Arena on August 21, 2027.

The band has performed theme songs for Bleach , Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood , Loups-Garous , Highspeed Étoile , Star Driver , GeGeGe no Kitarō , Pokémon the Movie: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction , and XFLAG and Marza Animation Planet 's original anime short "XPICE."

The band had toured in several countries including the United States, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and France, among others.

Scandal consists of lead vocals and guitarist Haruna, lead guitarist Mami, bassist Tomomi, and drummer Rina.

title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked TV Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content:
NBC Universal revealed two new cast members for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga on Monday. The new characters will appear in the anime's eighth episode on August 26.

Hiroki Nanami plays Sadame Mikuriya, the student council president.

Nao Tōyama plays Hachi Ura, the student council vice-president.

The anime stars:

• Hina Suzuki as Miya Nakamura

• Kujira as Teru Kōnokura

• Yū Serizawa as Marika Kōnokura

• Yuka Nukui as Arisa Kōnokura

• Anna Mugiho as Gungnir

• Miyari Nemoto as Yaeko Kōzō

• Yumi Uchiyama as Nago

• M.A.O as Mitsuya

• Hiroki Tōchi as Ueki

• Eiko Yamada as Yasu Nakamura

• Yō Taichi as Riru Kazan

• Momoka Terasawa as Koyuki Inari

Keisuke Inoue ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , Ao-chan Can't Study! , Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero ) is directing the anime at NEWON . Nanami Hoshino ( Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , Mission: Yozakura Family episode scripts) is in charge of series scripts, and Mutsumi Sasaki ( Chaos;HEAd , Laid-Back Camp , Phantom ~Requiem for the Phantom~ ) is designing the characters and is also the chief animation director.

Lia performs the opening theme song "Amayadori no Shōkei" (Longing to Take Shelter From the Rain), and AVAM performs the ending theme song "Claire."

Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Fairy tale tropes are turned on their heads in this award-winning and comedic reimagining of the classic Cinderella story! Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father's estate agrees to take her in, she's convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being...sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that's sure to put a smile on your face!

The manga launched on Ichijinsha 's Comic POOL digital manga magazine in November 2020. Ichijinsha will publish the manga's 10th compiled book volume on August 25. Seven Seas published the eighth volume in English on June 23.

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc Reveals 4th Trailer, Key Visual, NYCC Appearance with Mariya Ise
content:
The staff for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ( Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime, revealed on Monday its fourth trailer and a new key visual. The staff also announced that Mariya Ise will attend New York Comic Con , which is taking place from October 8-11, to promote the arc.

go!go!vanillas will perform the ending theme titled "TRICK STAR."

The arc will get advance screening events on September 6 at TOHO Cinemas Roppongi Hills in Tokyo, and on September 21 at TOHO CINEMAS Namba in Osaka.

Pony Canyon describes the new arc's story:

The conflict between Tokyo Manji Gang and Tenjiku came to a gruesome end. As each individual carries their sorrow and moves forward on their own path,Takemichi Hanagaki(TAKE‐MITCHY) finds himself in awe of the late Tetta Kisaki. Upon hearing the full truth behind the time leaps, Manjiro Sano (Mikey) makes a crucial decision. After leaving the past behind, Takemichi finally reaches the ultimate future where his beloved Hinata is alive. However, "he" is nowhere to be found. In the era of the “Three Titans,” where three teams battle for dominance, the final revenge begins!

New cast members for the anime include:

• Mariya Ise as Senju Kawaragi

• Naoyuki Shimozuru as Takeomi Akashi

• Shinnosuke Tachibana as Wakasa Imaushi

• Takanori Hoshino as Keizo Arashi

• Hiroki Yasumoto as South Terano

Maki Kodaira ( The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse ) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS , replacing Kōichi Hatsumi from previous anime seasons. Hatsumi is now credited with collaborating on overseeing the series scripts. Airi Tsuyuki and Kae Takakura join previous character designers Keiko Ōta and Kenichi Ōnuki . (Tsuyuki and Takakura were animation directors previously in the anime.) Yoshitomo Hara joins Hideki Fukushima as bike and prop designer. Hiroshi Yataka , who worked on photography for previous seasons, is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Hisayoshi Yamamoto from the previous season. LIDEN FILMS is credited for 3D CG work.

Returning staff members include Yasuyuki Mutō in charge of series scripts, Rumi Matsumoto as art director, Kunio Tsujita as color key artist, Satoki Iida as sound director, and Hiroaki Tsutsumi as music composer.

Boy band JO1 will perform the new arc's opening theme song "IGNITE."

Ken Wakui launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 2017, and ended the series in November 2022. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English.

The manga's first television anime adaptation premiered in April 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. The anime's Tokyo Revengers: Christmas Showdown arc premiered in January 2023 and aired for 13 episodes. Disney+ and Hulu streamed the arc as it aired.

Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku Arc ( Tokyo Revengers : Tenjiku-hen), the third season , premiered in Japan in October 2023. Disney+ exclusively streamed the anime worldwide (except in Mainland China).

The franchise has also inspired three live-action films.

Ken Wakui launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 2017, and ended the series in November 2022. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English.

The manga's first television anime adaptation premiered in April 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. The anime's Tokyo Revengers: Christmas Showdown arc premiered in January 2023 and aired for 13 episodes. Disney+ and Hulu streamed the arc as it aired.
Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku Arc ( Tokyo Revengers : Tenjiku-hen), the third season , premiered in Japan in October 2023. Disney+ exclusively streamed the anime worldwide (except in Mainland China).
The franchise has also inspired three live-action films.

The Tokyo Revengers anime is based on the manga by Ken Wakui. The manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Magazine from March 2017 to November 2022, officially ending on November 16 that year. The only girlfriend he ever had was just killed by a villainous group known as the Tokyo Manji Gang. He lives in a crappy apartment with thin walls, and his six-years-younger boss treats him like an idiot. Plus, he’s a complete and total virgin … At the height of his rock-bottom life, he suddenly time-leaps twelve years back to his middle school days!! To save Hinata, and change the life he spent running away, hopeless part-timer Takemichi must aim for the top of Kanto’s most sinister delinquent gang!!

title: New Rokudenashi Blues Manga Delayed to Winter, Gets New Artist
content:
This year's 18th issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine announced on August 19 that the launch of the upcoming Rokudenashi Blues Gaiden: Onikazura manga based on Masanori Morita 's Rokudenashi Blues manga is delayed from summer to winter and will now feature art by Yuki Yoshimoto .

Morita originally stated on X/Twitter in January that the manga is set in the first half of the 1990s, and is not a sequel, but is instead a story about "the fight between those two people" that took place during the manga but was never depicted. The manga will center on the characters Onizuka and Kasai, two of the "four heavenly kings" in the story.

Boichi was originally announced as the artist for the new series.

The original manga ran in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 1988 to 1997 and has 42 volumes.

The manga inspired a 1992 anime film, as well as the Rokudenashi Blues 1993 anime film.

The manga inspired two live-action films in 1996 and 1998, as well as live-action television series that debuted in 2011. A stage play adaptation ran in December 2010.

The manga centers on Taison Maeda, a student at Teiken High School in Kichijōji, Tokyo, who aims to become a professional boxer, and who overcomes many formidable opponents.

Morita's other manga include Rookies , Beshari Gurashi , and Zashisu , among others.

Yoshimoto and Jun'ichi Fujisaku launched the Ghost in the Shell: The Human Algorithm manga in Kodansha 's Young Magazine in September 2019, and ended the series on the Comic Days app in April 2025.

title: Umayuru Full Gate! Umamusume’s Next ONA Premieres in September
content:
Umayuru Full Gate! will be the next Umamusume: Pretty Derby anime. The short-form (three-minute) ONA will debut on the franchise’s YouTube channel this September. Cygames has released a visual for the upcoming anime and listed AtoriE as the studio. However, the company did not provide any information on the show’s production cast. The premiere will include subtitles in English, Korean, and Traditional Chinese. The franchise’s VAs will reprise their roles.

Scooter Films animated the original 24-episode Umayuru ONA, as well as the follow-up, 4-episode Umayuru: Pretty Gray ONA. AtoriE is a relatively new studio. They’ll adapt the upcoming I’m Dating a Dark Summoner and Ghost Meets Gal! s hort-form anime.

Unlike the franchise’s previous anime, Umamusume: Cinderella Gray, Umayuru Full Gate! will take a more playful approach to the franchise’s stories.

Cygames, Inc. announced the Umamusume: Pretty Derby mobilegame in 2016. However, the game missed its 2018 Japanese release date and was instead released in February 2021. Cygames later released the game globally in June 2025. Since then, Umamusume: Pretty Derby has become one of the company’s most profitable titles. The mobile game has since been adapted into several manga, light novels, anime, OVAs, ONAs, and a theatrical film.

Both the game and the franchise have been so well received that they’re credited with starting a global resurgence in the popularity of horse racing.

Umayuru Full Gate! focuses on anthropomorphized versions of real-world racehorses who aim to compete and win the prestigious Twinkle Series.
